title: 0.1.3: any motion on the float chain (shared_layout / enter_motion) breaks widget float interactions
Combobox/Select width only honors fixed px: relative() degrades to content width, no flex-adaptive trigger
0.1.2 regression: Table with fill_height realizes zero rows (header renders, body empty)
Host element slot: let a script view embed an opaque host-provided element (unblocks rhai-side chrome shells around host content)
Inline svg tint renders with red/blue swapped: gpui 0.2.2 ImageFormat::Svg skips the RGBA->BGRA conversion every other decode path performs
IconButton: no way to express a selected/toggled state (accent foreground, no fill) — icon color is locked to the variant
Inline svg() currentColor does not inherit ambient text color: unstyled icons silently render black
